### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **28** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/view.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**27** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cf43b6c38091eb15b5d0a4edcfc2080442018568`.

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/view.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/view.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **56** of **208** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **165** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cf43b6c38091eb15b5d0a4edcfc2080442018568` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2fcf7c9ee7995847556f44442dec133dd52161d8` — the merge of head `f282e8a966d52be3f95f34d415d2734501846076` into base `cf43b6c38091eb15b5d0a4edcfc2080442018568`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2fcf7c9ee7995847556f44442dec133dd52161d8 && git checkout 2fcf7c9ee7995847556f44442dec133dd52161d8
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cf43b6c38091eb15b5d0a4edcfc2080442018568 f282e8a966d52be3f95f34d415d2734501846076 && git checkout -B drift-repro cf43b6c38091eb15b5d0a4edcfc2080442018568 && git merge --no-ff f282e8a966d52be3f95f34d415d2734501846076

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cf43b6c38091eb15b5d0a4edcfc2080442018568
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cf43b6c38091eb15b5d0a4edcfc2080442018568` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Its committed tree touches the published schema (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `view.zod.ts`, `react-blocks.ts`, `conversions/registry.ts`, four new `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` entries) and one governed path (`skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`, regenerated by `gen:react-blocks`, no hand edit). The body also declares `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. That is a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review. The seat runs at `TIER_DEFAULT` because the ceiling model has been unavailable to the fleet since 2026-10-27, so it hands the review to triage. The PR stays draft on purpose: relay `pr_ready` on a Tier H diff requests the approvers.

Inputs for the reviewer:
- card #27159; ADR-0050 Decision 4, ruling 6464210455 (A′); order 6469180448, amendment 6469786533, claim 6469269349, os-dev report 6473832761; the face half landed on #27155.
- What must hold. `ObjectForm` keeps only simple, tabbed and wizard. The drawer and modal arms move byte-for-byte into `ObjectFormContainer`, and the block renderer routes drawer and modal there. The block's `formType: 'split'` is refused by name with a prescription. `splitDirection`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable` and the section `pane` are `retiredKey()` tombstones, and so is `FormViewSchema.splitDirection`.

Under the same-major rule the retirement is absorbed into #27155's D2 conversion `form-view-presentation-types-removed` (a new `convertBlock` over `object-form` page blocks) and its D3 entry, not a second kit.
- `@object-ui/types` keeps the three split keys declared as the spec's tombstones by reference (the `defaultFilters` precedent), so the mirror parity census still pairs them. The section `pane` member is removed.
- On #27153, measured: `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` keep a live reader (`ObjectFormContainer` → `DrawerForm`), so neither is retired here.
- Open sequence (seat-1 route): `73eb8292` held the skills reference at main's bytes, then `pr_create`, then `235fc7d7` reverted the hold. `requested_reviewers` read back empty. The net tree equals the dev's `6f5071c3`.
- CI at hand-off: `Lint · repo & tooling gates` and `Check Changeset` are red, and the dev is driving them. A later head that touches only the changeset or prose stays under this review. Any code change gets a delta read.

No reviewer is requested, and the PR stays draft until a PASS is on file and the seat's ACCEPT is posted (#26617).
